flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Open the first product.
Store its name as {{product_name}}.
Click "Add to cart" without ticking or choosing any extra options.
Then open the cart.
Store the names of every line item in the cart, separated by " | ", as {{cart_items}}, and store how many different line items are in the cart as {{cart_line_count}}.
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

remark: click: Clicking View deal for the first product
analyze: the product name is stored as {{product_name}}
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'how many different line items are in the cart is stored
wait: Waiting briefly with the cart open

summary:
Opened the first product, AirWave Pro Earbuds, and added it to the cart without selecting any extra options.
Opened the cart without entering payment details or placing an order.
The cart showed two line items: AirWave Pro Earbuds and ShieldPlus Protection Plan.
one_liner: added the first product to the cart on the local shop site
